explanations.positive_explanation: This neuron is a “new-section/title” detector: it spikes on the very first token of a document or section header (titles, headings, forwarded-mail dividers, etc.), especially when that token is capitalized and marks the start of a new block.
explanations.negative_explanation: This neuron fires on the “lead-in” token at the start of a new block or heading—short, often title-cased or uppercase keywords (version, PE, IP, Net, Cap…, z…, etc.) that label or kick off a document/section.
